EmailTemplate.subject: Eurasia Group Conference Call: Top Risks for 2013 (Today, 7 January, 10:00 New York)
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Please join Ian Bremmer and David F. Gordon as they discuss Eurasia Group's Top 10 Risks for 2013. This call will provide an overview of the key geopolitical areas to watch for global investors, business leaders, and market participants. There will be an opportunity to ask questions after the presentation.
During the following two weeks, Eurasia Group will host daily conference calls with senior analysts to focus in detail on each of the Top 10 Risks for 2013.
Date and Time:
7 January 2013 10:00 (New York) 7 January 2013 15:00 (London)
Speaker(s):
Ian Bremmer, President David F. Gordon, Head of Research
Topics:
Top Risks for 2013
